title: Ev_Stock_Arrived (inventory grants) is unassertable in demos and unasserted by any test
evidence:
harness/demo_parse.odin valid_event_name:
	switch s {
	case "packet_arrived", "packet_dropped", "forecast_issued", "warning_raised",
		 "crisis_triggered", "crisis_resolved", "grace_started", "grace_expired",
		 "run_won", "run_lost", "node_spawned", "meter_changed", "warning_cleared":
		return true
	}
	return false
(no stock_arrived case; event_matches likewise has none)
core/run.odin grant landing:
	for g in state.catalogs.balance.grants {
		if g.at_tick == tick {
			...
			emit(state, tick, Ev_Stock_Arrived{links = nl, routers = nr})
(grep: no test file references Ev_Stock_Arrived)
detail: The new grant event can't be expressed in a demo expect (valid_event_name omits it) and no unit test references it. Grant landing is only indirectly pinned by the surge golden's event-stream hash, with no explicit assertion.
recommended_fix: Add "stock_arrived" to valid_event_name + an event_matches case, and add a demo `expect event stock_arrived within <grant tick window>` or a unit test asserting it fires at scheduled ticks with correct link/router totals.

title: Demo `place_router` verb is parsed but exercised by no demo
evidence:
harness/demo_parse.odin:
	case "place_router":
		if len(fields) < 4 { return it, fmt.tprintf("line %d: place_router type x y", ln) }
(grep `place_router` under demos/ returns no match; all 7 .dem files use draw_pipe/upgrade_pipe/demolish only)
detail: The parser branch for place_router (demo_parse.odin:136,230) is dead in the demo suite. Cmd_Place_Router is unit-tested (test_place_router_rules) and one placement runs via surge's autopilot, but the demo string-to-command parser path is untested.
recommended_fix: Add a place_router step to a demo (e.g. draw_and_upgrade or a new inventory demo) to cover place->consume and demolish-node->router refund end-to-end through the parser.

title: Grant catalog validation error paths have no test
detail: Three fail-fast grant validation rules (ascending at_tick, unknown pipe tier, non-router type) ship with no test feeding a malformed grant catalog. Only the happy path is covered, implicitly via must_catalogs in other fixtures.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test that loads synthetic grant catalogs violating each rule (out-of-order at_tick, bad tier name, non-router router) and asserts the returned Catalog_Error field and rule string.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 ~100%: 7 demos goldened with T1+T2 and replay-verified (surge_basics.log.bin round-trips a tag-7 Cmd_Place_Router). P1 ~92%: inventory consume/return/exchange + Out_Of_Links/Out_Of_Routers/Invalid_Placement fully unit-tested; node-health + queue-overflow are real pins. Overall ~88%. One P2 hole: Ev_Stock_Arrived has no explicit assertion.
recommended_fix: Add the stock_arrived demo/unit assertion and a grant-catalog validation test to lift P1 toward ~98% and close the only new-feature event assertion hole.
